parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no additional results exist. If NextToken has a value, the value indicates the token to use for the next query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 2000.

parameters.name: UseNextToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

- **true**: Uses the NextToken method.
- **false**: Does not use the NextToken method.
